= = = =
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NIKHIL S. KARIEL
Heard learned AGP Ms.Roshni Patel for the appellant State and learned Advocate Mr.K. M. Sheth for the respondent - claimant.

2. By way of the present appeal, the appellant State has challenged the judgement and order dated 24.4.2012 passed by the Reference Court being learned Principal Sr. Civil Judge, Bharuch in Land Acquisition Reference Case No.193 of 2010.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Reference Case No.193 of 2010
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
It would be relevant to mention here that the land in question had been acquired for the purpose of Malpur Vishakha Canal under Narmada Project and whereas Notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") was issued on 17.8.2007 and Notification under Section 6 of the Act was issued on 2.5.2008.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer had passed his award under Section 11 of the Act on 25.2.2009,
awarding an amount of Rs.238/- per sq. mtrs., and whereas being aggrieved by the meagre compensation, the Claimant had challenged the same by way of a Reference as referred to herein above.

That vide the impugned C/FA/247/2013 ORDER DATED: 18/04/2023 judgement and order,
the learned Reference Court had inter alia valued the land at the rate of Rs.251.45 per sq. mtrs., and whereas additional compensation as per the value arrived at was directed to be paid to the claimant.

sentences.text: The said Reference is sought to be questioned before this Court.

3. At this stage, learned Advocate Mr.K. M. Sheth would submit that since a learned Coordinate Bench of this Court in groups of First Appeals being First Appeal Nos.1854 to 1867 of 2013 vide order dated 16.7.2013; First Appeal Nos.2423 and allied matters vide order dated 15.7.2014 and First Appeal Nos.2546 to 2553 of 2013 vide order dated 27.9.2013 had been pleased to confirm the award of the learned Reference Court in Land Reference Cases for the lands, which had been acquired for the very selfsame purpose situated in the very village, similar view may be taken in the present appeal also.

Learned Advocate Mr.Sheth would submit that since there are no special circumstance for arriving at the value of the land as could be discernible from the perusal of the decisions referred to herein above and since there is no difference between the lands which were subject matter of the appeals referred to herein above and the present land in question, therefore,
learned Advocate would request this Court not to allow this appeal and to decide this appeal in light of the decisions referred to herein above.
4. Considering the submissions made by the learned Advocate Mr.Sheth and since learned AGP Ms.Patel could not point out any special circumstance from any of the decisions for arriving at the value of the land at Rs.251.45 per sq. mtrs., and further considering the fact that the decisions of the learned Coordinate Bench have been accepted by the State, more particularly there being no appeal filed against the said decisions, in the considered opinion of this Court, no diverse view C/FA/247/2013 ORDER DATED: 18/04/2023 requires to be taken by this Court in the present appeal.
5. Having regard to the above observations, in the considered opinion of this Court, no ground for interference is made out.
Hence, the present appeal stands rejected.

(NIKHIL S. KARIEL,J) V.V.P. PODUVAL Special Land Acquisition Officer vs Abdul Aziz Musa Adam on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95843323/
